title: 16S rRNA Profiling of dental unit waterline (DUWL) wastewater samples Raw sequence reads
description: We employed longitudinal 16S rRNA gene sequencing paired with clinical activity logs to investigate the drivers of microbial community assembly in dental unit wastewater, specifically quantifying how clinical workload and diagnosis entropy shift ecological processes.
